headline: Ownership Battles Concentrate Along Six Fronts
war_summary: The latest returns keep Callahan’s Passage as the war’s busiest ownership front, with 69 events in 24 hours and five in the latest two-hour window; both casualty rates are high, and the two-hour pace is accelerating. Fisherman’s Row follows with 57 events, though only one arrived in the last two hours; its ledger is now uniformly Colonial-held despite frequent neutralizations and captures. Stlican Shelf logged 52 events, including two recently, and remains divided among six Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral base. Weathered Expanse recorded 24 events, but none in the latest two hours; casualty rates are climbing while its eight-Colonial, one-Warden balance remains unsettled. Mooring County shows 12 events, three in six hours, with fighting and enlistments accelerating around The Wind Hills; eleven bases are Warden-held and one Colonial. Nevish Line also has 12 daily events and eleven in six hours, though its immediate two-hour window is quiet; six Warden and two Colonial bases leave the sector exposed to further reversals. Elsewhere, activity is chiefly static, with Viper Pit the notable smaller front at three events in two hours.
